fusions.name: Rutting Clash
fusions.desc: Meets the target head-on for 14 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Warning Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps once, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. For 2 seconds after using it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Recoil Bound
fusions.desc: Springs 2 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip, Then Swing
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
